ambiguity_resolution.reason: The immutable parent leaves direction, range duration, thresholds, and lifecycle values unresolved; the child adopts one already-frozen contract without modifying the parent.
ambiguity_resolution.source_supported_interpretation: Exact semantic alias of five_minute_orb_long_v002; no alternative rule.

rules.claim_boundary: exploratory diagnostics only; no empirical, profitability, validation, holdout, production, or capital conclusion
rules.economic_mechanism: The range break may trigger stops and attract directional participation.

entry.pre_entry_invalidation: raw or cost-adjusted entry at or below rounded stop
entry.rule: exact next complete bar raw open

expansion.definition: completed decision-bar close strictly above unrounded range high
expansion.range_invalidation: any post-range completed close below unrounded range low before trigger

expected_failure_modes: modeled costs and adverse selection exceed any gross effect
range break is a liquidity sweep
volume confirmation arrives after price exhaustion

integrity.lookahead: only bars ending at or before decision cutoff plus next raw open

lifecycle.commission: $0.005 per share per order with $1 minimum per order
lifecycle.event_precedence: gap stop, intrabar stop, gap target, intrabar target, timeout, session liquidation
lifecycle.gap_through: long stop exits at min(open,stop); long target exits at max(open,target)
lifecycle.session_liquidation: close of 120th held bar or 15:55 bar close, with early-close fifth-bar-before-close, whichever occurs first

rules.market_assumption: A completed five-minute opening range summarizes early price discovery; a participation-confirmed upside close beyond that frozen range can continue.

opening_range.high: maximum unrounded high of the exact five bars
opening_range.low: minimum unrounded low of the exact five bars
opening_range.realized_volatility_proxy: unrounded range high minus unrounded range low; recorded through the bound high/low snapshots and not used as an additional eligibility gate

target.rule: cost-adjusted entry plus two times initial per-share risk

trigger.rule: first completed eligible post-range bar satisfying expansion and volume
trigger.tie_breaking: earliest signal timestamp then immutable strategy identity

volume_confirmation.baseline: median volume at the identical minute label
volume_confirmation.history: twenty most recent prior eligible complete non-early-close non-halt sessions
volume_confirmation.point_in_time_rule: only sessions strictly before the decision session
